answer_1.quote: We evaluate SDM's ability to generate dialogues with phonetic characteristics. ... The SDM processes voice input and delivers voice response.
answer_1.outputs: audio responses and corresponding transcribed text

answer_2.quote: The accuracy (i.e., the proportion of instances judged correct out of the total number of instances) is regarded as the metric.

answer_3.quote: We adopt different methods for different categories ... For most tasks, except for generating audio with correct phonological features ... we design an automatic LLM-based evaluation method following the paradigm of LLM-as-a-judge. DeepSeek-R1 and GPT-4o are selected as LLM judge.

answer_4.quote: We first conduct a human evaluation on the generated responses by GPT-4o-Audio-Preview ... three human experts manually label whether each response is correct.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators label whether each response is correct.
